svg.title: gdfaler / projects under the hood
svg.desc: Egor, gdfaler. CS student at BMSTU. Native macOS apps, systems, graphics and machine learning. Cycles through identity and original schematic illustrations of DynamicIsland, HWMonitor and TorrentPlayer. These illustrate application capabilities, not live measurements. TorrentPlayer is an early MVP. Full text and project links are below the image.
